faqs.q: How do I convert Markdown to Word?
faqs.a: Drop a .md file onto the page, choose one, or paste your Markdown, then click Convert to Word. Download the .docx, or copy the formatted text and paste it into Word.
Yes. It is free and open source, with no sign-up and no limit on how many documents you convert.

faqs.q: Are my documents uploaded to a server?
faqs.a: No. Conversion happens entirely in your browser using JavaScript. Your Markdown and the Word document never leave your device and are never uploaded, stored, or logged.

faqs.q: How do I turn a ChatGPT or Claude response into a Word document?
faqs.a: AI chat apps answer in Markdown. Use the response's copy button, paste it here, and convert. Headings, lists, tables, and code come through as real Word formatting instead of stray asterisks and pound signs.

GitHub Flavored Markdown: headings, bold, italic, strikethrough, bulleted and numbered lists, task lists, tables, links, inline code, fenced code blocks, block quotes, and horizontal rules. The first heading becomes the document's title and file name.

faqs.q: Can I paste the result into Google Docs?
faqs.a: Yes. Click Copy formatted text and paste into Google Docs or Word, and the formatting comes with it. You can also download the .docx and open it in Google Docs.

faqs.q: Can it format a Chinese official document (公文)?
faqs.a: Yes. Choose the Chinese official document (公文) style before converting. Body text is set in FangSong, headings in FZXiaoBiaoSong, SimHei, and KaiTi at the customary sizes, with Times New Roman for Latin text. Those fonts need to be installed wherever the document is opened.

faqs.q: How is this different from Pandoc?
faqs.a: Pandoc is a powerful command-line converter, but it has to be installed and configured first. Markdown to Word runs instantly in your browser with nothing to install.
